items.label: Daily Drawdown
items.detail: Maximum loss allowed within one trading day. Trading day runs from 17:00:00 NY Time to 16:59:59 NY Time the following day. Open equity and floating losses are included. Static — does not trail upward. Hard Breach = immediate account termination.

items.label: Maximum Drawdown
items.detail: Total loss allowed from the Initial Account Balance. Static — does not trail upward with profits and does not adjust based on the highest account balance reached. Open equity and floating losses are included. Hard Breach = immediate account termination.

items.label: Floating Drawdown
items.detail: Unrealised loss on open positions on the same symbol, measured as % of Initial Account Balance, on a combined basis per symbol. Threshold is 2.0%. Reaching the threshold results in a soft warning/notification only. Unlimited soft warnings may be issued during the Pro Challenge Phase.

items.label: Minimum Profitable Days
items.detail: Required to progress through each Pro Challenge stage. A profitable day = account balance at 17:00:00 NY Time exceeds previous trading day's closing balance by at least 0.5% of Initial Account Balance.

sections.title: Funded Phase — Risk Parameters (Funded Finotive Pro 2-Step)

items.label: Daily Drawdown
items.detail: Same as Pro Challenge Phase. Hard Breach = immediate account termination.

items.label: Maximum Drawdown
items.detail: Same as Pro Challenge Phase. Hard Breach = immediate account termination.

items.label: Floating Drawdown
items.detail: Threshold is 2.0% per symbol on combined basis. An early soft reminder may be issued when Floating Drawdown reaches 1.5%. If Floating Drawdown reaches or exceeds 2.0%, it results in 1 Strike and payout reduction to 10% for the relevant payout cycle. Only one Strike per trade and instrument combination. Five cumulative Strikes = permanent account closure.

items.label: Minimum Profitable Days Between Payouts
items.detail: Required before payout or scaling request. Profitable day = account balance at 17:00:00 NY Time exceeds previous trading day's closing balance by at least 0.5% of Initial Account Balance.

items.label: Trade Consistency Rule
items.detail: From the 31st day of Funded Status, and on a rolling seven-day basis, the trader's weekly trade count and instrument volumes must remain within plus or minus 25% of the averages recorded during: (a) the Challenge Phase, AND (b) the first 30 days of Funded Status. Example: avg 10 trades/week at 10 lots Forex → must trade 7–12 trades and 7.5–12.5 lots. Breach = automatic account downgrade.

items.label: Quarterly Profitability Rule
items.detail: Within each rolling 90-day period, the trader must generate combined realised and unrealised profit of at least 5% of the Initial Account Balance. Example: $100K account with $4,000 in payouts → account must have ≥ $1,000 balance at the 90-day mark. Breach = automatic account downgrade.

items.label: Breach Consequence
items.detail: Breach of either Pro rule results in: (1) Automatic Account Downgrade to the equivalent standard funded Challenge account, (2) Permanent removal of all Pro-specific benefits, (3) Permanent removal of the 100% profit split. The downgraded account continues as a standard funded Challenge account.

items.label: Hard Breach
items.detail: Triggered by: (1) Daily Drawdown breach, (2) Maximum Drawdown breach, or (3) Five cumulative Strikes.

items.label: Soft Breach — Notional (Pro Challenge)
items.detail: Soft Breach — Immediate Strike. If account balance is negative, the reset is placed on hold until trader returns the account to at least break-even. Five cumulative Strikes = permanent account closure.

items.label: Soft Breach — Notional (Funded Pro)
items.detail: Payout reduction to 10% for the relevant payout cycle. Five cumulative Strikes = permanent account closure.

items.label: Pro Rule Breach
items.detail: Breach of Trade Consistency Rule or Quarterly Profitability Rule = automatic permanent downgrade to standard funded Challenge account. All Pro-specific benefits (incl. 100% profit split) permanently removed.

items.label: Profit Split
items.detail: Starts at 80%. Increases to 100% on the 30th funded day if account is in profit. On-demand after completing 2 minimum profitable days between payouts.

items.label: Salary
items.detail: Daily salary accrues from the first funded day regardless of trading profit. Revoked permanently on downgrade.

items.label: Payout Cycle
items.detail: First payout on-demand after MPD met. Subsequent payouts available weekly.

items.label: Payout Reduction
items.detail: Each Strike in the Funded Pro Phase reduces the relevant payout cycle to 10%. If a Strike has been issued, trader must withdraw the full available amount — partial withdrawal is not permitted.

items.label: Fee Refund
items.detail: 100% challenge fee refunded on the 30th funded day if account is in profit.
